QuestInfo.name: Weapon Starts a Fight... with His Owner?
QuestInfo.1: #p1201000# alerts you that #p1201002# is acting strange once again and urges you to visit #b#m140000000##k immediately. She also warns that she's never seen it act this way...
QuestInfo.2: #p1201002# seemed to be in great pain. What's going on here?
QuestInfo.0: You've hit Lv. 100, and #b#p1201000##k suddenly wants to talk to you. What could she want?

0.0: How is the training going? I know you're busy, but please come to #b#m140000000##k immediately. The #b#p1201002##k has started to act weird again... But it's even weirder now. It's different from before. It's...darker than usual.

yes.0: I have a bad feeling about this. Please come back here. I've never seen or heard #p1201002#, but I can sense the suffering it's going through. #bOnly you, the master of #p1201002#, can do something about it#k!

no.0: I'm not joking! Something is seriously wrong... Something must have happened to #p1201002#!

1.1: Aren't you... Aran? What are you doing here? I see... So that cocky little girl brought you here. I warned her not to...

npc.0: Please, go and take care of #b#p1201002##k! I have a feeling that if you don't go soon, it may be too late!
